notes.title: 🎶 Extra Coin Soundtrack On Vinyl 🎶
notes.content:
Hey everyone!  

We’re excited to announce that the original soundtrack of Extra Coin is getting a limited edition vinyl release!

notes.title: Extra Coin v1.3.0 - Patch Notes 🎮
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

Extra Coin v1.3.0 is here, and we're excited to share it with you!

This update marks the end of the bugfixing and polishing phase, delivering the best possible gameplay experience with deep polish, enhanced narrative flow and pacing, and fixing bugs reported by our amazing community. We truly appreciate all your support in helping us make the game better.

⚠️ This patch will also be released for the Switch version as soon as possible (about 2 weeks, if we are lucky with the certification process).

As always, you can follow the progress of our bug fixes in our Bugfixing Roadmap.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38801073/9a07f3c8441d7bf8c44148444064c4b676f2dbe4.png

Patch Details

- Tons of polishing fixes, with improved direction and timing throughout the story
- Fixed autosave breaking the loop even [reported by Lucaffo, puppamilaspranga, WildSpamtonFan]
- Fixed a bug preventing the break loop path from continuing when saving the game under certain conditions [reported by Frank Lioty]
- Fixed Mika IRL on break loop events if occurring after a login [reported by Althura]
- Fixed save dates updating every time upon reaching the main menu [reported by Lucaffo]
- Fixed a bug that blocked the game if the player paused during field swapping in duels [reported by Althura]
- Fixed duplicated Mika visible on the field after closing the leaderboard view [reported by Althura]
- Fixed panorama interaction not being restored after the Gardens event in chapter 4 [reported by Kitos]
- Fixed missing music when looking at the photo in Marsh's apartment [reported by Althura]

Moving Forward

Thank you again for your amazing support. We're planning to take a short break before resuming support for the game. Our next steps will focus on balancing minigames and duels difficulty, as well as introducing new features. We can't wait for you to dive in. 🔥

Join our Discord for exclusive updates and to connect with the community: link

notes.title: Dev Diary #3 - Our inspirations
notes.content:
Hey gamers!
In this new entry for our dev diary we’d like to share with you the main inspirations behind Extra Coin. If you’ve played the demo and have been wondering where the ideas for The Arcade and its inhabitants came from then you’re in the right place!

The real world
We decided to set the story in a dystopian foreseeable future, around the years 2050 to 2070. Most of it will take place in the arcade, a social network where people upload their consciousnesses to live a better life than the one in the real world which has been destroyed and torn apart by endless wars between corrupt governments. The world we see outside of Mika’s window is futuristic yet not that far from us. Our main inspirations here were some of the most famous cyberpunk works which describe a reality not too far away from us that has developed some very advanced and complex technologies even though the world is in shambles. Quoting cyberpunk’s most important author, William Gibson, we tried to represent a reality consisting of “high tech and low life”. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38801073/f24a47d0b130fa6b1eb1d104be3cedb24ae0f9f2.jpg
The Arcade
Striving for a better life, a big part of the population, including Mika’s parents, decided to upload their minds to a virtual reality that allows its inhabitants to live in a seemingly peaceful and colorful world. This metaverse is called The Arcade and in order to access it Mika has to wear a VR headset that, as some of you might have noticed, resembles the one from “Ready Player One” and even “Neuromancer”. The theme of uploading one’s consciousness to escape reality is a common one between sci-fi and cyberpunk tropes more specifically. You might remember “San Junipero”, the brilliant episode from season 3 of the show “Black Mirror”, or even “Upload”, the tv series that covers similar themes to the ones in Extra Coin. As soon as you enter the arcade you’re met with a neon-lit room, you might have caught the Tron reference for the futuristic and sci-fi aesthetic of this room.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38801073/bb34327d105024cac97d8745f3aea86c635e300e.jpg
The themes
Ever heard of transhumanism? It’s a philosophical and intellectual movement that pushes the idea that humans should use science and technology to enhance their capabilities. The whole point at the base of transhumanism is aiming to transcend our current biological limitations. Scary? Or maybe interesting? When exploring this very controversial movement we started wondering how far technology could get when trying to make us “better humans”. The Arcade is a new reality that makes life better for its users by letting them escape from the wreck of the world and making them transcend their biological limitations one of those being, you guessed it, death. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38801073/7fc29c16d9a7936e298792c20f04dc3156d81503.jpg
That was a lot, enough for this log. We hope you’re enjoying this journey to the release of Extra Coin. Feel free to jump into our Discord server to keep updated about all the news regarding the game!

Game on,

notes.title: Dev Diary #2 - The Inhabitants of The Arcade
notes.content:
Hi guys!
Today we focus on the characters that live inside the virtual world of The Arcade, helping you better understand the difference between them and what to expect from them!

NFA

It stands for No Fame Avatars and is a derogatory term coined to refer to the generic avatar used by all inhabitants of The Arcade. Being completely identical in their appearance, NFAs attempt to be unique by wearing accessories bought from vendors around the city. In The Arcade you can always tell a book by its cover and that's why NFAs have a different color depending on their moral conduct: cyan for Lurkers, magenta for Fame Diggers [we'll explore this in a future dev diary].

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38801073/a8c11efe262170a262ca2abe54dfd5c357e6b2d7.png

Champions

In The Arcade, the inhabitants duel with each other trying to climb the world ranking. Champions are the celebrities of the social network. Stripped of their NFA, they are the only ones who have their own customized avatar, as well as unique passive skills and ultimates. In the history of the social network, only 12 users have managed to reach the top, and from year to year their level has become so high that other users can't even try to get close to the upper level of the ranking. Unlike NFAs, they don't live in the city but some of them like to visit it by interacting with ordinary inhabitants.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38801073/4e6fa8880f324ff9b35d4785f1bf7f2c534c4cbc.png


That's all for today! Feel free to join our Discord community to keep updated about all the news regarding the game!

notes.title: Dev Diary #1 - Core Mechanics
notes.content:
Hi everyone!
Today we are happy to kick off our dev diary that will let you discover more information about Extra Coin! And where should we start this journey if not from the heart of our game? Without any further ado let’s talk about the core mechanics!


Explore the city and its places
The Arcade is a virtual social network into which the entire world population has poured its existence. Its inhabitants live in a proper virtual city full of places to visit and things to do. You will lead Mika, the protagonist of our adventures, around such places, interacting with her unique NPCs and discovering the secrets behind the social network itself.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38801073/877f7a4d5702ef21d253c3e1744a37d3e58e3cd4.png

Duel against your foes!
In The Arcade the inhabitants are all part of a special ranking and everyone wants to climb it in order to achieve more fame and success. To do so, the inhabitants duel with each other during the so-called Match Days. Winning these matches will be crucial to Mika's fortune, as they will allow her to gain Followers, which can be used as currency inside The Arcade.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38801073/f8fcce26d0c12c534a14ffd93f4cdf4ca00b0f03.png

Develop your character
As you climb the ranking, matches will become more challenging. To cope with them at best, it’s essential that Mika gets stronger and stronger. Depending on your own playstyle, you’ll be able to develop her stats and talents, choosing from a wide range of ultimates and passive skills. If that is not enough, you can customize her appearance with a considerable amount of cosmetics. They won’t affect her performance on the pitch, but - you know - looks matter too. 


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38801073/8649409f4895a36c804ef536c3157bd5ee9c5f53.png

Enjoy local activities, posting on your social profile
Dueling is not everything for the inhabitants of The Arcade. That’s why they enjoy the many activities available around the city on the so-called Free Days. Mika can spend her time at the training centre, go to a concert, relax at the cat café or maybe watch a movie. Whatever your choice is, each activity will grant her specific perks. At the end of it, Mika will also have to document it on her social profile. Feeding your followers is vital, so be careful with your posts too. Some followers may not like your content, ending up losing them. Remember: followers = money!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38801073/9d2702bc12e766b9a489a3af8d039c343cd93342.png

Make friends
No matter if The Arcade is a virtual world, relationships are still essential. That’s why Mika will be able to bond with other NPCs, becoming their friend and even unlocking special bromances that will influence the course of her story itself. There are plenty of characters you can interact with in the city. It’s up to you to find them all and pick the one you feel will have the biggest impact during your journey inside The Arcade. Choose your bestie wisely!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38801073/03a6bfa8bc10a115b7417b18a4aee80182ba808b.png

That pretty much sums it up. Feel free to join our Discord community , there will be important news soon!
